vulnerabilities.sink_description: While decoding the AcDb:Classes section of a crafted DWG, an invalid section size lets the reader run past the end of the heap-allocated file buffer. ASan: 1-byte READ one byte left of a 652-byte region in bit_read_RC (src/bits.c:320), reached via bit_read_RS -> bit_read_RL -> decode_R13_R2000 (src/decode.c:682).
fix_commits: ae09b9b7b51bda4a719279a6ade6dadeaf5ef39f (decode: fail on wrong r2000 Classes header, Fixes GH #615, 2023-01-30)

evidence.tested_commit_in_report: 3c90dc6641e11e486666940d7f354d2df54503d6 (0.12.5.5010); 93c2512 is an ancestor and predates the fix

alternatives.note: heap-buffer-overflow in bit_utf8_to_TU (GH #681); reproduced via dwg2SVG in the report, not dwg2dxf, so a weaker match for this binary.
